title: Power Stack Watchlist
method: Action-oriented queue combining thesis quality, current price location, technical confirmation and the active macro regime. Candidate scores are not the same as the fundamentals-only holding scores.
marketRegime: Renewed US-Iran/Hormuz escalation has pushed Brent above $90, lifted energy shares and long yields, and raised the hurdle for expensive long-duration equities. Physical AI/grid/water bottlenecks remain structurally preferred, but entry discipline matters more as rates rise.

buckets.label: Buy / Accumulate
buckets.description: Price and thesis are aligned enough for staged entry.

buckets.label: Selective / Retest
buckets.description: Good business or theme, but entry quality needs a better level or confirmation.

buckets.label: Wait / Confirm
buckets.description: Interesting exposure, but current risk/reward is not strong enough to force.

buckets.label: Avoid / High Risk
buckets.description: Theme may be attractive, but company, dilution or earnings risk currently dominates.

candidates.name: Quanta Services, Inc.
candidates.entry: $600–610; add more on a constructive retest of ~$595–600
candidates.thesis: The correction has returned the stock to the prior buy zone while the grid/time-to-power thesis remains intact. Record backlog and large-load interconnections still make Quanta one of the cleanest physical-AI exposures, although the premium multiple argues for staged entries rather than chasing.

candidates.name: CGN Power Co., Ltd.
candidates.confirmation: Hold above HK$3.00 and reclaim HK$3.06–3.08
candidates.thesis: The stock is essentially unchanged from the prior snapshot and continues to hold the HK$3 area. Operating reactors and a visible construction pipeline remain a cleaner nuclear expression than pre-revenue SMR duration.

candidates.name: Xylem Inc.
candidates.thesis: The price has reached the old invalidation/support area, improving valuation but removing the luxury of a loose stop. Water and cooling remain durable physical bottlenecks; this is now an asymmetric support test rather than a blind accumulate.

candidates.name: Tenaga Nasional Berhad
candidates.theme: Malaysia power · data centres · regulated grid
candidates.thesis: The structural case is stronger than the headline earnings noise: Malaysian data-centre demand, grid reinforcement and regulated asset growth remain core bottlenecks. The stock has moved slightly above the original entry, so prefer pullbacks rather than chasing.

candidates.name: MN Holdings Berhad
candidates.invalidation: Sustained break below ~RM3.20–3.25 or backlog/margin deterioration
candidates.theme: Substations · grid connections · Malaysia data centres
candidates.thesis: FY26 revenue rose about 61% and PAT about 92%, with substation engineering driving the business. The earnings now validate the Malaysia grid bottleneck thesis, but the stock has already rerated materially, so this is a selective entry rather than a momentum chase.

candidates.name: Modine Manufacturing Company
candidates.invalidation: Fresh structural low below ~$174–175 without a benign market explanation
candidates.thesis: The stock has fallen through the prior $180–185 planned entry, improving price but weakening trend. Reported data-centre growth keeps the fundamental thesis alive; require support to hold before sizing up.

candidates.name: Halliburton Company
candidates.action: BREAKOUT CONFIRMED — BUY RETEST, DON'T CHASE
candidates.invalidation: Failure back through ~$35 and recent higher-low structure
candidates.thesis: The old confirmation level has broken as crude risk premium returned. The signal is tactically better, but Halliburton ultimately needs sustained upstream spending rather than one geopolitical oil spike, so buy the retest rather than the headline.

candidates.name: Ranhill Utilities Berhad
candidates.invalidation: Break below ~RM2.30 or renewed margin disappointment from electricity costs
candidates.theme: Johor water · data centres · physical AI bottleneck
candidates.thesis: Ranhill is the direct Johor water-infrastructure adjacency: planned data-centre build-out could add roughly 700–800 MLD of demand and the tariff schedule includes a dedicated data-centre rate. Stronger FY26 earnings help, but electricity is a major operating cost, so rising energy prices are a real counterweight.

candidates.name: Ford Motor Company
candidates.thesis: Price remains exactly around the planned entry, but the macro backdrop is less friendly: higher oil, gasoline and bond yields can pressure consumers and auto financing. Keep the value thesis, reduce urgency and position size.

candidates.name: McDonald's Corporation
candidates.thesis: The stock has moved away from the preferred entry while energy and food inflation remain uncomfortable. Franchise quality is defensive, but beef/input costs and lower-income traffic keep this a value-watch rather than a chase.

candidates.name: Chevron Corporation
candidates.action: STRONG BUSINESS — DON'T CHASE WAR PREMIUM
candidates.confirmation: Sustained breakout after crude volatility normalises
candidates.invalidation: No thesis break; current issue is entry quality
candidates.thesis: Chevron benefits from the current oil tape and has additional Venezuela optionality, but the stock is now above the prior starter zone. The business has improved tactically while the entry has worsened.

candidates.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp.
candidates.invalidation: Loss of IPO/support area without a new catalyst
candidates.thesis: NASA launch execution and the move into gas-turbine/time-to-power infrastructure broaden the strategic story, but very large capex and further share unlocks keep valuation discipline essential.

candidates.name: China Resources Power Holdings Co., Ltd.
candidates.thesis: The pullback improves the entry but CGN remains the cleaner China-power expression. Keep watching for another 2–5% decline into the preferred zone rather than forcing it here.

candidates.name: Enphase Energy, Inc.
candidates.entry: No aggressive entry; only a small reversal setup above $35–36
candidates.thesis: The stock is cheaper but has moved toward invalidation while rates are rising. Weak revenue guidance and tariff pressure still dominate; falling price alone is not an upgrade.

candidates.name: NuScale Power Corporation
candidates.confirmation: Base + higher high after dilution overhang
candidates.thesis: The nuclear theme remains strong but NuScale is moving the wrong way and still carries financing, dilution and commercialisation risk. Operating nuclear remains the preferred vehicle.

candidates.name: Xinyi Solar Holdings Ltd.
candidates.theme: Solar glass · China solar supply chain
candidates.thesis: The latest 6%+ daily drop reinforces that this is not simply a cheap technical setup. Industry oversupply and impaired profitability still outweigh the theme.
